scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned, bearded man in ivory robes and a rust-colored mantle lowers a silver bowl into a linen-lined wooden chest. Gold and silver pitchers and bowls fill nearby shelves and a table; a sunlit temple is visible through the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Solomon's careful placement of a silver bowl imagines the storing of David's dedicated treasures after the temple was completed. The other vessels represent the silver, gold and furnishings named in the verse. His appearance, clothing, chest and First Temple setting are illustrative conventions, not historical likenesses or archaeological reconstructions. David is absent.
